_about: Registry of pipeline networks for the gem.wiki network pages. One entry per PipelineNetworkGrouping value on the Gas tab. PrimaryNetwork is the English name (the network page's title), PrimaryNetworkLocalLanguage the value the sheet holds today. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-08_network-pages.md. Rebuild the counts from a fresh snapshot with the plan's audit script; the names and notes are hand-set.
scope: China gas only (Baird 2026-11-08). Networks outside China are on hold and not listed. Oil is out of scope.
source: live Gas tab, read 2026-11-08 after the China spelling fixes; Status = N/A rows dropped; the one row with a blank grouping (P-row Sarybulak-Zimunay Gas Pipeline, Kazakhstan–China) has no network and is not listed.

sheet_columns.PrimaryNetwork: English network name; one value per row; every row of one PipelineName carries the same value. Counted into the network's rollups (length, status mix, map).
sheet_columns.PrimaryNetworkLocalLanguage: The network name in the local language; for China the Chinese characters now in PipelineNetworkGrouping.
sheet_columns.SecondaryNetworks: English network names separated by ';'. Navigation only: listed under Connected pipelines on each named network page, drawn lighter on its map, never in its totals. Empty for most rows.

networks_tab.created: 2026-11-08 from this registry (Baird asked for the tab; 72 rows, A1:N73, RAW, verified by re-read; backup notes/sheet-backup-2026-11-08-gas-pipeline-networks-tab.csv)

columns.NetworkID: N0001.. in NetworkName order at creation; stable key, never renumbered
columns.NetworkName: English network name; the value PrimaryNetwork and SecondaryNetworks carry on the Gas tab
columns.NetworkNameLocalLanguage: the local-language name (Chinese characters now in PipelineNetworkGrouping)
columns.NetworkType: kind (provincial network, trunk line, import line, ...)
columns.SegmentCount: rows on the Gas tab at creation (snapshot, not a formula)
columns.Wiki: the network page URL (for WikiPageKind = network page (to create) the page does not exist yet)
columns.WikiPageKind: pipeline page | network page (existing) | network page (to create)

networks_tab.dropdowns: Gas tab PrimaryNetwork (A4:A4632) and SecondaryNetworks (C4:C4632) carry a strict dropdown from 'Gas pipeline networks'!B3:B (set 2026-11-08). SecondaryNetworks allows multiple selections (switched on in the Sheets UI; the API has no field for it), so its separator is ', ' as Sheets writes it. A new network is added to the tab (and here) before any row can use it.

page_kinds.trunk line: a long-distance line with its branches
page_kinds.connecting line: a link between two networks or trunks
page_kinds.export line: a line out of mainland China
page_kinds.coal-to-gas line: a line from a coal-to-gas plant

secondary_proposals._about: Seeds for the SecondaryNetworks column, Guangxi pilot only. A pipeline is listed here when it touches the network's province without belonging to it. Baird decides each.

Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network.Nanning-Pingxiang Gas Pipeline: West-East Gas Pipeline 2 (P7668 is grouped there today; after the move to Guangxi it stays connected to WEGP 2 as a secondary)
Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network.West-East Gas Pipeline 2: Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network (Baise, Wuzhou–Hezhou and Yulin–Guigang branches run inside Guangxi; the Guangzhou–Nanning branch was Guangxi's first supply)
Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network.Sino-Myanmar Gas Pipeline: Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network (the China trunk ends at Guigang; the Xincheng-Guilin branch is in Guangxi)
Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network.Chongqing-Guizhou-Guangxi Gas Pipeline: Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network (proposed; ends in Guangxi)
Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network.Luzhou-Zhaotong-Bijie-Baise Pipeline: Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network (proposed; ends at Baise)
Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network.Xinjiang Coal-to-Gas Pipeline: Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network (Guangxi Branch, P4753)
Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network.Guangdong West Gas Pipeline Network: Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network (Maoming–Yangjiang segment P4694 starts in Guangxi; check whether the start province is right before tagging)
